purpose: Document first-party Egyptian cadastral-source discovery and bounded public-service review for Al Roda, Egypt.
assessment: The official ESA site establishes a national survey/cadastral custodian and documents digital-map, topographic-map, historic-map, and map-room services. Its current Egypt map page is a static ASP.NET page with a Google Maps JavaScript include; it does not expose a public parcel layer, native parcel identity field, CRS/schema, or anonymous geometry endpoint. No Al Roda-local cadastral service was verified.
registryAssessment: registryFound=null: a national custodian is evidenced, but no local Al Roda registry, cadastre, map, or parcel procedure was specifically evidenced.

officialPrimarySources.observation: ESA describes its historical and current role in producing maps and ownership/cadastral records for agricultural land and built property, but provides no Al Roda parcel endpoint.
Official Egypt map page retrieved over TLS. HTML is an ASP.NET form with a Google Maps JavaScript include; no parcel layer/API/configuration or safe parcel schema was present.
Official services index lists digital maps, historic maps, topographic maps, coordinate certificates, and land-boundary services. These are service descriptions, not an anonymous parcel query API.
Official digital-map sales page describes requesting GIS/CAD/PDF/JPG/orthophoto products with a specified projection; it requires a service request and does not publish a parcel feature service.
Official historic-map page includes historic cadastral-map descriptions, but its public listing is not an Al Roda parcel dataset or current parcel API.
Official zemam-map page exposes historical-map selection fields; no Al Roda current parcel geometry or anonymous feature response was available.
